description: A disorder characterized by widespread musculoskeletal pain accompanied by fatigue, sleep, memory and mood issues.
causes: Genetics, infections, and physical or emotional trauma.
prevention: No known way to prevent, but managing stress and staying active can help.
treatment_action: Pain relievers, antidepressants, anti-seizure drugs, and physical therapy.
complications: Depression, anxiety, and reduced quality of life.

description: A common skin condition in which hair follicles become inflamed.
symptoms: Clusters of small red bumps or white-headed pimples
prevention: Avoid tight clothing, shave with care, and keep skin clean.
treatment_action: Antibiotic or antifungal creams, and warm compresses.
complications: Boils, permanent skin damage, and scarring.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: Illness caused by eating contaminated food.
causes: Bacteria, viruses, or parasites in food.
prevention: Wash hands, cook food thoroughly, and store food properly.
treatment_action: Fluids and rest. Antibiotics may be needed for bacterial cases.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: An injury caused by freezing of the skin and underlying tissues.
causes: Exposure to cold-weather conditions or direct contact with ice or frozen metal.
symptoms: Cold skin and a prickling feeling
Skin that looks red, white, bluish-white or grayish-yellow
prevention: Dress in layers, protect hands and feet, and limit time in the cold.
treatment_action: Rewarming the affected area and medical evaluation.
